title: Demonstration against gender-based violence in Jerez

tea.why: Participants gathered to denounce gender-based violence and commemorate the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women.
tea.want: The demonstration called for an end to violence against women and for perpetrators to be held accountable.
tea.changed: Nov 25: A demonstration took place in the city center, featuring a banner display at the City Hall and a poetry reading.

summary: On November 25, 2026, a demonstration was held in the center of Jerez de la Frontera to mark the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. Organised in coordination with the local government and the Local Council of Women, the event included the display of a banner on the City Hall facade by Mayor María José García-Pelayo and other officials. The protest served as a public denunciation of gender-based violence and a call for equality. Activities included a poetry reading by a local student and speeches from city leadership, who emphasised the need for continued awareness and legal action against abusers. The event saw participation from local government representatives, women's associations, and members of the public, reflecting a collective stance against violence.
response: The local government, led by Mayor María José García-Pelayo, participated in the event, displaying a banner at City Hall and calling for the imprisonment of abusers.

updates.text: A demonstration and banner display took place in Jerez to mark the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women.
